title: fix(core, service-messaging): a failed settings read is retried, not dead-lettered as TEMPLATE_INVALID
body:
domain:server#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUCizoYWQVJWjhdR6F

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuPMZ8BHWtPf6nBTp51qSM64)_

Fixes #27257

Clause-②: yes (widening) — `resolveLocalizationContext`'s result (`@objectstack/core`) gains one optional member, `readFailed?: true`. Nothing is narrowed.
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`resolveLocalizationContext` 的结果新增可选字段 `readFailed: true`,只在直连 `sys_setting` 读取抛错时出现(新读与 30 秒失败记忆命中都带)。消息服务的邮件、站内信渠道据此区分:读失败时不带币种照常渲染;若被拒(`TEMPLATE_INVALID`),再以 ISO「无币种」码 `XXX` 作默认试渲染一次(只渲染、不发送):能过,说明唯一的拒绝是缺默认,改记为可重试;仍被拒(如 `@path` 值错误),原样返回那句拒绝、判永久。读成功且确实没有默认币种时,仍是 `TEMPLATE_INVALID`、永久失败、带补救说明。
- 为什么改:原先读失败与"没有默认币种"都返回 `currency: undefined`,一次瞬时的设置读取故障会让带无参 `currency` 洞的邮件进死信,永不发送。分诊 6496449802:读失败是瞬时的,要重试;只有读成功且无默认才是永久的。
- 风险与回滚:扩大一个已发布导出类型(可选字段,`Clause-②: yes (widening)`),7 个调用方源码兼容、类型检查通过;失败记忆不加长,#11877 不变。不含无参 currency 洞的模板在读故障期间照常发送。回滚即 revert。
- 先看:`packages/core/src/security/resolve-authz-context.ts`(结果类型与 `resolveLocalizationContext` 中 `value` 的构造及失败记忆写入);`packages/services/service-messaging/src/email-channel.ts` 的 `templateRefusalAfterCurrencyReadFault`;`messaging-service-plugin.ts` 的 `getTenantCurrency`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-messaging exec vitest run src/template-tenant-currency.test.ts`,预期 21 条全过(读失败两渠道判 retryable、记忆命中同样、读成功无默认判 permanent、读失败下与币种无关的拒绝判 permanent)。
- 需要你做的:在本 PR 上批准这次公开类型扩面(分诊 6506866652 所要求);契约复核与增量复核均已 PASS(6508920767、6509670944),批准后席位落地。

## What changes

**The resolver says which of the two it is.** `resolveLocalizationContext` already computed `backendFailed` (the direct `sys_setting` read threw) but returned only the value, and the failure memo returned the bare value on a hit. The answer now carries `readFailed: true` in that case. It is built once and the memo stores that same object, so a hit inside the 30 s failure TTL says the read failed too. A settings-service refusal still does not count as a backend fault (#11877 unchanged), and the memo's lifetime is unchanged. On every successful read the member is absent.

**Messaging grades from it.** `getTenantCurrency` (`messaging-service-plugin.ts`) keeps its signature and rejects when the read failed; with no default after a successful read it answers `undefined` as before. The email and inbox channels catch the rejection, render without a currency, and pass a render failure through `templateRefusalAfterCurrencyReadFault` (`email-channel.ts`, shared by both channels, not exported from the package entry): a `TEMPLATE_INVALID` that followed a failed read triggers ONE trial render (render only, never sent) with the ISO no-currency code `XXX` as the default. If that render passes, the missing default was the only refusal, and the failure is recorded as `the template was not rendered: the organization's default currency could not be read (...); the delivery is retried until that read succeeds`, which carries no `TEMPLATE_*` code, so `classifyError` grades it `retryable`. If the trial render still answers `TEMPLATE_INVALID` (for example an `@path` value refusal a default cannot cure), that refusal is returned as is and stays `permanent`. An email service with no `renderTemplate` cannot tell the two apart and is graded retryable (the helper's docblock says so). Every other failure and every refusal after a successful read is returned unchanged.

**Public surface.** One optional member on the result type of an exported function of `@objectstack/core` (reachable from the package root through `security/index`). No new export name, no input change. `EmailChannelOptions` / `InboxChannelOptions` are unchanged in type; their `getTenantCurrency` JSDoc now states the rejection.

## Tests

- `packages/core/src/security/resolve-localization-read-failed.test.ts` (new): a throwing direct read answers the built-ins with `readFailed: true`; the memo's hit keeps it with no second read; a successful read with no currency has no `readFailed`; a settings refusal in front of a successful direct read has none (#11877); past the TTL a recovered read answers the stored default with no kind (the memo is not lengthened).
- `resolve-authz-context.test.ts` and `resolve-localization-cache.test.ts`: two existing failure-memo pins that compared the whole answer with `toEqual` now include `readFailed: true` (moved pins, same behaviour otherwise).
- `packages/services/service-messaging/src/template-tenant-currency.test.ts`: through the plugin's own wiring (`MessagingServicePlugin.init`, `kernel:ready`, `getChannel`), for both the email and inbox channels: a failed read renders without `currency` and the refusal is `retryable` with no `TEMPLATE_` text; a second delivery served from the failure memo is `retryable` again with no second read; a successful read with no default gives exactly the render's `TEMPLATE_INVALID` sentence (with its remedy), graded `permanent`; a template that needs no default is delivered during a read fault; `TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND` after a failed read stays `permanent`; a read that finds `CNY` formats in it; under a failed read, an `@path` refusal stays `permanent` as is, and a template with both a missing default and an `@path` refusal returns the `@path` refusal, `permanent`, nothing sent (2 pins per channel); the retryable pins assert the trial render used `XXX` and sent nothing.

## Acceptance notes

- **Branch name.** The card thread's harness-pinned branch `claude/project-thread-tfwfer` names no issue; claim 6507228661 is the identity record.
- **Same family, not here.** `plugin-auth` (`withMailTenantCurrency` wiring) and `service-automation` (`setTenantCurrencyResolver` wiring) also read a failed read as no default; triage filed them as #27710, `Blocked-by: #27257`, which reads the new member.
- **A persistent fault.** Where the direct read fails for a long time (a `sys_setting` table that does not exist yet), a delivery whose template has a no-argument `currency` hole is now retried along the retry ladder before it dead-letters, instead of dead-lettering at once. A template without such a hole is unaffected.
- **The PR body's attribution lines** name this card thread (the harness requires its own thread link), not the seat thread `order-common.md` names.

  - A1, no kind on the fresh answer (`value = read`): core 3 of 5 red, messaging 4 of 17 red.
  - A2, the memo stores the bare value (`value: read` in the failure entry): core 1 red (the memo-hit pin), messaging 2 red (the memo-hit pins).
  - A3, the plugin never rejects: messaging 4 red.
  - A4, the channel never re-grades: messaging 4 red.
  - A5, the channel re-grades every `TEMPLATE_INVALID`: messaging 3 red (both "no default stays permanent" pins and the existing permanent pin).
  - The first A4 attempt was refused by the tool (its replacement text already occurred in the file) and restored; it was rerun with a distinct replacement.
